title: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Manila Leg 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: PUMA Manila Half Marathon 2026 Review | SM Mall of Asia
meta_description: PUMA Manila Half Marathon review: the 2025 race at SM Mall of Asia on 5 October kicked off the series, with a surprise men's winner and Maricar Camacho first again.
dek: The Manila leg of RunRio's PUMA Philippine Half Series opened the 2025 series at the SM Mall of Asia complex on 5 October. Here is what that race was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The PUMA Manila Half Marathon is the Metro Manila stop of RunRio's PUMA half-marathon series, run from the SM Mall of Asia complex. The 2025 race, on Sunday 5 October, opened the series [1]. Newcomer Simon Enriquez won the men's 21 km in 1:23:05 and veteran Maricar Camacho the women's in 1:30:54 [1]. Christine Hallasgo won the women's 10 km in 38:32 [1]. It is a well-sponsored city half marathon with a 10 km and 5 km alongside. The winning times suggest a slower, less elite front of the race than the provincial legs. For 2026 it moves to the end of the series, as the finale.

sections.heading: The 2025 Race
paragraphs: The PUMA Manila Half Marathon 2025 was run on Sunday 5 October 2025 at the SM Mall of Asia complex, as the opening race of the PUMA Philippine Half Series [1]. It was organised by RunRio, with the Department of Tourism's support [1].
There were three distances: the 21 km, a 10 km and a 5 km [1]. RunRio's general manager, Andrew Neri, described it as the start of the series for Filipino runners [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Simon Enriquez, a newcomer, won the men's half marathon in 1:23:05, ahead of Joram Lava (1:24:23) and Moiselle Angelo Alforque (1:25:22) [1]. Maricar Camacho won the women's in 1:30:54, ahead of Jennelyn Isibido and Danica Shasha Tan [1].
In the 10 km, Rico Jay Patanao won the men's race in 32:44 and Christine Hallasgo the women's in 38:32 [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon in Metro Manila with a big series and sponsor behind it, yes. In 2026 the Manila leg closes the series at the SM Mall of Asia complex, after legs in Clark and Cagayan de Oro [2].
If you are after a podium, note the 2025 winning times: 1:23 for men and 1:31 for women on the half marathon. At the 2026 Clark leg they were 1:09 and 1:21 [2].
This review is compiled from a published race report on the 2025 Manila race. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Who won the PUMA Manila Half Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: Newcomer Simon Enriquez won the men's 21 km in 1:23:05 and Maricar Camacho the women's in 1:30:54 on Sunday 5 October 2025 at the SM Mall of Asia complex. Christine Hallasgo won the women's 10 km in 38:32.

faqs.question: Where is the PUMA Manila Half Marathon held?
faqs.answer: At the SM Mall of Asia complex in Pasay, Metro Manila. In 2025 it opened the PUMA Philippine Half Series; in 2026 the Manila leg is the series finale, on 11 October, after legs in Clark and Cagayan de Oro.

faqs.question: What distances does the PUMA Manila Half Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Three in 2025: the 21 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km. The race is organised by RunRio with PUMA as title sponsor and support from the Department of Tourism.
